0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz host the Miami Heat in their 11th game of the season. The Jazz are 1-9 overall and 1-4 at home, on an eight-game losing streak, while Miami is 4-6 and has won its last game. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their two meetings in 2025-26, with the Jazz winning the most recent one 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
